description: This file defines a React component for creating or editing session data within a learning management system. It handles form state, validation, loading existing session data, and submitting new or updated session information. It interacts with external modules for data fetching, user authentication, and utility functions.

methods.name: SessionFormPage({ mode })
methods.description: Main React component handling session creation and editing UI, state, validation, data loading, and submission logic.

methods.name: loadCourseOptions
methods.description: Fetches list of courses user can manage or view, updating component state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads session data if editing and fetches course options.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a session with validation and redirects.
